correctness.rationale: For n>=4, coordinate distances at cyclic separation k are q_k=4R^2 sin^2(kπ/(2n))+[k odd]h^2. Within parity classes q_k strictly increases. For odd n the unique maximal q_n is a perfect matching of opposite indices and q_(n-1) the penultimate; for even n the unique maximal q_(n-1) has separation n-1, gcd(n-1,2n)=1 so the forbidden graph is C_(2n) and q_n is second-largest, with triple-angle inequality ensuring the gap. Inclusive penultimate clique complex is Ind(forbidden graph); Kozlov recurrence proves integral wedge types and at diameter all edges yield a simplex. Independent coordinate enumeration n=4..21 reproduced shell values and exact forbidden graphs. Universal proof is analytic, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: Finite numerical q_k checks alone cannot establish n-uniform completeness.
